# SetGadgetShape <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Gadgets](BlitzPlus-Gadgets)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SetGadgetShape:Void gadget:Int32, x:Int32, y:Int32, width:Int32, height:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gadget` | In | Int32 | required | Handle of the gadget. |
| `x` | In | Int32 | required | New horizontal position. |
| `y` | In | Int32 | required | New vertical position. |
| `width` | In | Int32 | required | New width. |
| `height` | In | Int32 | required | New height. |

## Description

Moves and resizes a gadget, also a window. The numbers are relative to the group.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Shape", 10, 10, 300, 140, Desktop(), 3)
b   = CreateButton("Jump", 10, 10, 100, 28, win)
Repeat
	e = WaitEvent()
	If e = $401 Then SetGadgetShape b, Rand(0, 150), Rand(0, 60), 100, 28
Until e = $803
```
